name: molecule
definition: 由两个或更多原子通过化学键结合而成的电中性粒子集合，以唯一标识与标签加以区分。 Counterexample: 易与「原子」混淆：原子是单一元素的最小单元，而分子由多个原子经化学键连接构成。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table molecule; provenance: direct source molecule

name: atom
definition: 构成分子的基本粒子单元，具有元素种类属性并归属于某一分子。 Counterexample: 易与「分子」混淆：分子是多个原子的集合体，原子是其中不可再分的组成单元。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table atom; provenance: direct source atom

name: bond
definition: 分子内两个原子之间按特定键型建立的连接关系实体，以唯一标识区分。 Counterexample: 易与「连接记录」混淆：化学键是键型与所属分子的载体，连接记录仅记录两端原子与所引用键。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table bond; provenance: direct source bond

name: connected
definition: 记录两个原子由某一化学键相连的信息性条目，包含两端原子标识与所引用键标识。 Counterexample: 易与「化学键」混淆：化学键是键本身的实体，连接记录是描述该键连接哪两个原子的信息条目。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table connected; provenance: direct source connected

name: Molecule
definition: A molecule entity identified by molecule_id in the molecule table.

name: Atom
definition: An atom entity belonging to a molecule, identified by atom_id.

name: Element
definition: The chemical element symbol of an atom, stored in atom.element.

name: CarbonAtom
definition: Atoms whose element is carbon ('c').

name: Bond
definition: A bond entity identified by bond_id in the bond table.

name: BondType
definition: The type of a bond, stored in bond.bond_type.

name: SingleBond
definition: Bonds whose bond_type is single ('-').

name: DoubleBond
definition: Bonds whose bond_type is double ('=').

name: TripleBond
definition: Bonds whose bond_type is triple ('#').

name: CarcinogenicLabel
definition: Molecules whose label is '+' indicating carcinogenic.

name: NonCarcinogenicLabel
definition: Molecules whose label is '-' indicating non-carcinogenic.

name: ConnectedAtom
definition: Atoms that appear in the connected table as atom_id or atom_id2.

name: UnconnectedAtom
definition: Atoms that do not appear in the connected table.
scope: atom where atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected UNION SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected)

name: AtomPosition
definition: The positional digit within an atom_id, e.g. substr(atom_id,7,1).

name: CarbonPercentage
definition: Share of atoms that are carbon among a set of atoms. Formula: CarbonAtom / Atom. Inputs: CarbonAtom = atom.element WHERE element = 'c'; Atom = atom.atom_id

name: DoubleBondPercentage
definition: Share of bonds that are double bonds among a set of bonds. Formula: DoubleBond / Bond. Inputs: DoubleBond = bond.bond_type WHERE bond_type = '='; Bond = bond.bond_id

name: SingleBondPercentage
definition: Share of bonds that are single bonds among a set of bonds. Formula: SingleBond / Bond. Inputs: SingleBond = bond.bond_type WHERE bond_type = '-'; Bond = bond.bond_id

name: TripleBondPercentage
definition: Share of bonds that are triple bonds among a set of bonds. Formula: TripleBond / Bond. Inputs: TripleBond = bond.bond_type WHERE bond_type = '#'; Bond = bond.bond_id

name: AverageCarcinogenicSingleBonded
definition: Average number of single bonds per carcinogenic molecule. Formula: SingleBond / CarcinogenicLabel. Inputs: SingleBond = bond.bond_type WHERE bond_type = '-'; CarcinogenicLabel = molecule.label WHERE label = '+'

name: AverageCarcinogenicDoubleBonded
definition: Average number of double bonds per carcinogenic molecule. Formula: DoubleBond / CarcinogenicLabel. Inputs: DoubleBond = bond.bond_type WHERE bond_type = '='; CarcinogenicLabel = molecule.label WHERE label = '+'

name: AverageCarcinogenicTripleBonded
definition: Average number of triple bonds per carcinogenic molecule. Formula: TripleBond / CarcinogenicLabel. Inputs: TripleBond = bond.bond_type WHERE bond_type = '#'; CarcinogenicLabel = molecule.label WHERE label = '+'

name: BondsPerMolecule
definition: Number of bonds associated with a molecule. Formula: Bond / Molecule. Inputs: Bond = bond.bond_id; Molecule = molecule.molecule_id

name: AtomsPerMolecule
definition: Number of atoms associated with a molecule. Formula: Atom / Molecule. Inputs: Atom = atom.atom_id; Molecule = molecule.molecule_id

name: ConnectionsPerAtom
definition: Number of bonds connected to an atom. Formula: Bond / Atom. Inputs: Bond = bond.bond_id; Atom = atom.atom_id

name: CarcinogenicMoleculeShare
definition: Share of molecules that are carcinogenic. Formula: CarcinogenicLabel / Molecule. Inputs: CarcinogenicLabel = molecule.label WHERE label = '+'; Molecule = molecule.molecule_id

name: NonCarcinogenicMoleculeShare
definition: Share of molecules that are non-carcinogenic. Formula: NonCarcinogenicLabel / Molecule. Inputs: NonCarcinogenicLabel = molecule.label WHERE label = '-'; Molecule = molecule.molecule_id

name: MajorityBondType
definition: The bond type with the highest count within a molecule. Formula: MAX(COUNT(BondType)). Inputs: BondType = bond.bond_type; Bond = bond.bond_id

name: UnconnectedAtomShare
definition: Share of atoms that are not connected to any bond. Formula: UnconnectedAtom / Atom. Inputs: UnconnectedAtom = atom.atom_id WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected UNION SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected); Atom = atom.atom_id

name: Carcinogenicity
definition: Answers whether molecules are carcinogenic based on label, and counts by label.

name: BondType
definition: Answers questions about bond types and their distribution.

name: ElementType
definition: Answers questions about elements present in atoms and molecules.
